name: zclass_world_to_grid_coords_clamped
description: zClass_World::WorldToGridCoordsClamped clamps world coordinates using the recovered +/-0.1 bounds rules and converts them to grid column/row.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the x87 comparisons and _ftol conversions remain expanded in HLIL; assembly and smoke coverage support tier C equivalence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450790 validates reading worldData through world->classData, +/-0.1 clamp constants, areaInvSizeX/Z multiplication, _ftol conversions, writing outGridCol/outGridRow, and return 0.
The native world-to-grid smoke verifies representative unclamped, lower-clamped, and upper-clamped coordinate conversions using production code.
